description: Create a new short link on filoo. Returns the short_url (filoo.app/{username}/{slug}) and the link code. Use this whenever an agent needs to shorten a URL, hand a clean URL to a user, generate a QR-friendly link, or attach click tracking to an outbound URL. Counts against the daily creation quota and active link cap — call filoo_usage first if unsure.

destination.description: The long URL to shorten (http or https).

label.description: Optional private label shown only in the dashboard.

slug.description: Optional custom slug like 'spring-sale'. Alphanumeric + hyphens, 1–64 chars. Auto-generated if omitted.

username.description: Username to publish under. Defaults to the user's primary username.

name: filoo_create_link
